subject: Question on shiny-server/shiny versions and IE

messages.author: 70abc85dd4bcb117
messages.subject: Question on shiny-server/shiny versions and IE
parts:
Hi all:

We have shiny-server 3.6 using shiny 0.6.0 since we were unable to install newer versions on our SLE 11.02 server (mostly due to blocking of the git protocol by IT).  This is working fine for all of our apps using Chrome.  We are now trying to deploy another app more broadly in the organization and IE is the default browser and installation of a new browser requires IT involvement. I am finding that any calls to renderPlot or renderUI do not produce any output with IE8 or IE9 but work fine with Chrome.  Is this a problem due to the versions I am working with, and if so, could someone point me to instructions on how to set up an account on glimmer or spark or whatever it is called to deploy this one app (since we don't have to be on our internal network for this one).

Thanks,

Mike

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Question on shiny-server/shiny versions and IE
parts:
Hi Mike,

With the later versions of Shiny Server, you should be able use IE8 or IE9 for everything except file upload. We are only aware of the upload issue. To try out your application you can definitely do it on spark or glimmer servers; we can setup an account for you.
However, since we will be winding down Spark and Glimmer this year in favor or ShinyApps.io, I recommend that you create an account on ShinyApps and give that a try. Go to http://www.rstudio.com/shiny/hosted/ for registering, and https://github.com/rstudio/shinyapps/blob/master/guide/guide.md for instructions on how to setup and get started.

Let us know if you still want an account on Glimmer/Spark.

Fereshteh
